question:
Select the most appropriate 'one word' for the expression given below. 

Something that is no longer in use.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Obsolete'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is **"Obsolete".**
 
• **"Obsolete" **refers to something that is no longer produced or used; out of date.(अप्रचलित)
 
• This term perfectly describes something that is no longer in use.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Obsolete'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Absolute" **(सम्पूर्ण, पूर्ण) generally means total, complete, or not limited by anything.
 
• **"Vogue"** (फैशन, प्रचलन में) refers to the prevailing fashion or style at a particular time. It represents something that is in use or popular at a particular time, which is the opposite of what the prompt is asking for.
 
• **"Contemporary"** (समकालीन) refers to something happening or existing now, or belonging to the same time or period.

42:Tafa,

The correct answer is 'Option 2'
